figures.9: printed p. 108 (index 39): weight-per-cent projection from olivine into CS-MS-A

digitisation.raster: each page rendered at 300 dpi with PyMuPDF; pixel coordinates refer to that raster (origin top-left)
digitisation.ticks: tick marks on horizontal or vertical axes located automatically as short strokes perpendicular to the axis (centre of the stroke); ticks on slanted axes read by eye at 5-7x zoom with a 1-px grid, at the junction of tick and axis line
digitisation.points: arrow symbols (DIOPSIDE, PYROPE) read at the arrow apex on the axis; open circles read at the centre dot (Fig. 10) or ring centre (Fig. 9) at 9x zoom; natural rocks: crosses read at the intersection of the strokes (10x zoom), filled dots located as the centroid of the solid blob and checked at 10x zoom
digitisation.uncertainty: per-point reading uncertainty in the uncertainty_px column; the tick-fit RMS measures the drafting precision of each figure's scales
digitisation.calibration: least-squares affine map fitted only to the printed ticks of the same figure; no engine output enters the calibration

compositions.DiXPyY: synthetic mixture of X wt% diopside and Y wt% pyrope (O'Hara & Yoder 1967, table 1, as labelled on Figs 9 and 10)
compositions.TYS:<label>: analysis labelled <label> in data/tilley_yoder_1963_1964_analyses.csv (Tilley, Yoder & Schairer 1963, 1964; label mapping in its provenance.json)

labels_read_as.Fig 11 vertical scale: ticks printed with paired labels 'Wt% MgO' and 'Wt% C3A' (50/10, 40/20, 30/30, 20/40 ...), i.e. MgO + C3A = 60, so the scale is the line SiO2 = 40 wt%
labels_read_as.Fig 11 upper edge: ticks printed 45, 50, 55 = wt% SiO2 on the olivine-enstatite (C3A = 0) edge

not_digitised.Fig 4B: same base and diopside template as 4A, and its natural points (Green & Ringwood) have no accessible analyses

status.discrepancy: Fig. 5 '1921': plotted 3.0 wt% from analysis 14, the analysis of the 1921 lava named by the sources and the one that matches O'Hara's own Fig. 4C point (0.25 wt%); it lies within 0.11 wt% of Y&T Table 2 no. 12, another analysis of the Kilauea olivine tholeiite. Reported, not scored.
